25001.story: As of Oct 12, June to July is the driest pair on the middle value of the county's 8 grids in Barnstable County, with 5.67 inches normal, and it came in under 90% of normal in 37 of 75 years since 1951. Every grid had its driest year in 1965, as low as 53% on grid 26338.
